quests.title: A Small Token

dialogue.t: Is the tea to your liking? Or would you prefer something with a little more bite?
Tea is fine. I feel guilty drinking during the day. Best not to do it too often...
Anyway, Miss Guillotin, what brings you to Natlan?
I'm just traveling around, visiting old acquaintances. Besides, I wanted to thank you for agreeing to help out during the Fontinalia Festival.
You're too polite. Did you really come all the way here just for that?
Well... Although you were gracious enough not to bring it up last time, I'm well aware I've caused you trouble in the past.
Ah... That business with your subordinate? The incident involving the robot, Ineffa...
Heh... Isn't life strange? You might suddenly find yourself friends with your former enemy's boss... You might even find they become your own boss...
I hope you can accept this as a small token of apology.
Th—This... It's a limited edition... No, a collector's edition!? And it's my favorite genre!? H—How did you know...
I asked {NICKNAME} for advice. He(She) has a pretty good grasp of your reading preferences.
{NICKNAME}...!?
(Ugh...! What's with these conflicting feelings!? It's like I'm pleased but also embarrassed.)
(Naturally, I'm flattered he(she) knows what I like, but does he(she) really have to go shouting it from the rooftops? I'd rather he(she) just gave me a gift himself(herself)!)
Do you like it?
Ah... Th—Thank you! You're too kind, Miss Guillotin.
If it's the type you like, then next time, I can bring you some more. Of course, when the time comes, I'll have to trouble {NICKNAME} to pick them out with me.
...W—With you!? You mean... You went to the bookstore together to get this!?
Yes. He(She) seemed intent on choosing the perfect one. Maybe next time...
...There'd better not be a next time!!!
Oh... I... Uhm...
Ugh... Just wait till I get my hands on him(her)!

dialogue.sit: (Let's sit like this for a little while longer.)
I think it's time I started clearing up.

dialogue.t: Is that the time? Alright, Miss Guillotin, be careful on the road.

quests.description: Go to the Masters of the Night-Wind, place your tea table, and have Sandrone take a seat. Then, prepare to enjoy some tea with Citlali…
